history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure compliance with the delivery principles when recognizing expenses and that it upload all relevant documents in Umoja.
history.administration_response: The Administration continues to hold year-end meetings with heads of offices to emphasize the importance of complying with the delivery principle and recognize expenses in the appropriate financial year, where all relevant documents are uploaded in Umoja. To comply with the delivery principles, service entry sheets and goods receipts that are not posted in time are captured by the accrual of expenses from outstanding commitments whose services and goods are delivered by the end of the year. Hence, expenses for the services and goods delivered are fully recorded or accrued.
history.board_assessment: Given that some documents were not uploaded in Umoja, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
